stem: Which joined the Winter Olympics first?
measure: year first held at the Winter Olympics
explanation: Men have jumped at every Winter Games since 1924, but women waited until Sochi in 2014. Snowboarding had already arrived 16 years earlier, at Nagano in 1998.
learnMore: Ski jumping at the Winter Olympics

claims.text: Snowboarding was first held as an Olympic event at the 1998 Winter Olympics in Nagano.
Women's ski jumping was first held at the Winter Olympics in 2014, in Sochi.
Men's ski jumping has been held at every Winter Olympics since the first, in 1924.
